reviewScope: Full eleven-file source diff; authenticated date/principal group discovery, exact static wire projection, canonical action guard compatibility, runtime-owned current-request admission, publication metadata and synthetic regressions. Successor exact-head review additionally verifies only the source-author timestamp and immediate authoring-parent metadata changed.
analysis: Group discovery authenticates and validates exactly one matching teacher/date selector, bounds and validates numeric unique group options, keeps scripts inert, and labels options route candidates rather than student membership.

Wire projection requires one popup source and one empty g_param declaration; preserves every full handler, literal assessment option, and complete parameter/event suffix. Existing canonical action validation, fresh before-state, previous-record identity, exact approval digest, readback and unchanged-field checks remain unchanged.

Request admission captures exact action digests, independently compares current request evidence through a trusted runtime-owned port, and delegates exclusive durable consumption using a stable identity excluding attempt ID/output path. No model-facing approval flag or Hermes-only business requirement is introduced.
Source qualification records contain bounded metadata and hashes; no student histories, credentials, source session bodies or business-send authority are published.

Independently inspected the successor diff and exact parent: only .github/source-author.json sourceBaseSha and capturedAtUtc changed. sourceBaseSha equals the immediate source parent; capturedAtUtc is canonical JavaScript UTC milliseconds-Z. All previously reviewed application code and tests remain byte-identical. Existing author identity and nonauthentication flags remain unchanged.

validation.check: canonical verifyCommittedSourceAuthor at exact current head

limitations: The actual independent reviewer is collaboration agent /root/academy_delivery_review. Its inherited CODEX_THREAD_ID is not a distinct session identity.
Publisher custody and canonical structural proof validation are not cryptographic native authentication, runtime permission, deployment authority or teacher acceptance.

This is source review. Synthetic regression tests do not prove live operational correctness. The reviewer executed no Academy operation and did not rerun the full root check; parent-reported full checks and actual SDK observations are separate evidence.

The source-owned runtime integration must supply a genuine current user-event reader and exclusive durable consumption. Interface declarations and provenance locators alone do not authenticate user intent.

priorReview.relationship: Exact full original review plus independently reviewed metadata-only successor delta; original raw report preserved unchanged.
